items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: The fella called Zeb, you know, he was playing with us then.

ctx.x: How high could your brother go?

How high could your brother go? Well, the fellas say he made F on the trumpet, above the staff. F. One day he made F. When they didn't drink that night, he was feeling good. He'd come out there and he made F. And E and all that stuff. He used to go so much, it almost sounded like a whistle. But the tone was clad the crystal, he'd make it clad. And I'll tell you how they know that. You see the fellas just take them on the clarinet. The fella called Zeb, you know, he was playing with us then. And he used to make…
What was Zeb's last name? Do you know?
